user.title: AIL: Aziende Industriali di Lugano
user.description: Enter your credentials for AIL EnergyBuddy. You can find your account details at [{login_url}]({login_url}). If you don't have an account, you can create one at [{account_create_url}]({account_create_url}).

mfa.title: AIL Email Verification
mfa.description: AIL requested a second authentication step. Enter the verification code sent to your email address.

tariff.title: Energy Tariff Configuration
tariff.description: Configure your electricity tariff settings. If you enable fixed tariff, you'll need to enter your peak (day) and off-peak (night) rates in CHF/kWh. Default values are set according to AIL standard rates.

reauth_credentials.title: Reauthenticate with AIL
reauth_credentials.description: The stored AIL credentials were rejected. Enter the account credentials again; AIL will e-mail a verification code next.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the service. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid authentication credentials. Please check your username and password.
error.invalid_mfa_code: The verification code was rejected. Request a new code and try again.
error.mfa_session_expired: The verification session expired. A new code is required.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs for more details.
error.invalid_price: Invalid price value. Please enter a valid number.

abort.entry_not_found: The AIL configuration entry no longer exists.
